name: TTS_01_Product_And_Outlier_Radar
description: TikTok-Shop Radar v2.1: Checks @bizpunk72 live readiness, discovers 5 weekly viral trend candidates every Sunday (status=candidate), and provides 1-Click Telegram Inline Approval (Approve / Winner / Pause).

main.node: Insert New Trend Candidates Into tts_products

parameters.jsCode:
const products = $('Load Approved Products').all().map(i => i.json || {}).filter(p => p.product_key);
const htmlItem = $input.first()?.json || {};
const html = String(htmlItem.data || htmlItem.body || '');
let followers = 1607;
const m = html.match(/<script id="__UNIVERSAL_DATA_FOR_REHYDRATION__"[^>]*>(.*?)<\/script>/);
if (m) {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(m[1]);
    const ui = parsed?.__DEFAULT_SCOPE__?.['webapp.user-detail']?.userInfo || {};
    followers = Number(ui?.stats?.followerCount || followers);
  } catch (e) {}
}

const existingKeys = new Set(products.map(p => p.product_key));

    cb_pause: 'tts_pause|' + c.product_key,
    cb_winner: 'tts_winner|' + c.product_key
